messages:
ravi: Hey folks, first day! Quick checklist question: who do I ping for SSH keys, KMS/Vault access, repo perms, PagerDuty, and who owns the Dedicated tenant provisioning? Trying to get a minimal list to bookmark.
marta: welcome @ravi!! Short list: SSH keys & cloud console -> eng-infra, KMS/Vault -> security-infra, repo perms -> eng-platform, PagerDuty/oncall -> eng-sre, Dedicated tenant provisioning -> solutions-eng + customer-success.
li: For SSH: run the self-serve key upload at https://redwood.internal/ssh-keys and then open #help with subject "ssh key add" if you run into bastion errors. Include your username and which jump host.
sam: Vault/KMS access needs a brief justification. Use the access form: https://redwood.internal/access-requests and select "vault-role". Time-limited tokens are common if you only need short-term access.
emily: Repo perms: use the perms form and list exact repo paths and role (read/write/admin). Admin requires your manager + security sign-off. If you need a fast write grant for onboarding, tag @eng-platform in the form.
devops-bot: [automated] When paging oncall or requesting urgent access, include: service, env, impact, and a short log/command. Example payload:
```
service: redwood-dedicated-staging
env: staging-us-east-1
impact: 502s on /health, 20% errors
logs: tail -n 100 /var/log/inference/serve.log | sed -n '1,40p'
```
ravi: Great, thanks. If I'm triaging and I see errors that look like model mismatch vs infra (e.g., wrong model version served), who do I page?
marta: Rule of thumb: connectivity, IAM, storage, and VPC issues -> eng-infra. Token latency, model outputs/versions, KV cache -> eng-runtime during business hours; if it's customer-impacting outside hours page eng-sre. For Dedicated customer incidents always cc customer-success.
li: Also: billing/quota emergencies -> finance-ops alias. Dedicated tenant creation or permission changes that touch customers -> always notify account's CS rep.
sam: We keep a lightweight "who-to-ask" matrix on the DevEx wiki; owners are @marta and @li. Link: https://redwood.internal/devex/onboarding/who-to-ask. If you notice gaps please open an MR.
ravi: Perfect — super helpful. I'll do SSH + perms form and attach training certs for any console requests. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
